    • of

      static LogFormatter.ThrowableFormatter of()
      Default implementation uses Throwable.printStackTrace(PrintWriter). This formatter is equivalent to of(Integer.MAX_VALUE, List.of()) except that it defers entirely to Throwable.printStackTrace() and thus will respect any override of that method a particular Throwable subclass might have.
      Returns:
      formatter.

    • builder

      static LogFormatter.ThrowableFormatter.Builder builder()
      Creates a builder for a throwable formatter that can limit the number of stack frame lines shown for each throwable in the cause/suppressed chain, exclude frames matching regular expressions, and append packaging data. The output is otherwise formatted like Throwable.printStackTrace(): common frames shared with the enclosing throwable are elided the same way (e.g. "... 6 more") as long as the depth limit was not what stopped printing; if the depth limit is what stopped printing a "... N frames truncated" line is emitted instead.
      Returns:
      builder.
      API Note
      a builder left at its defaults (no max lines, exclusions, or packaging data) builds of() itself; otherwise the built formatter walks Throwable.getCause()/Throwable.getSuppressed()/ Throwable.getStackTrace() directly instead of calling Throwable.printStackTrace() and thus will not honor a custom override of that method.
